works.title: Wisdom Nexus
works.description: A personal knowledge archive system designed to transform years of accumulated wisdom into shareable solutions for humanity's challenges. Combines structured knowledge organization, visual pattern documentation (30+ visual thinking patterns with use cases), and AI-powered infrastructure (orchestrator pattern with Python/FastAPI/RAG) to create a process library for exploring and ideating complex problems.
works.quote: This project is my mind's living archive, transforming years of accumulated knowledge into shareable solutions for humanity's challenges.
